title: Enforce customer invoice and receipt invoice-allocation authority at every entry
description: Close remaining customer invoice/receipt-invoice allocation waivers in the receivable chain. CustomerSalesInvoiceEvidenceController RequiresLiveAuthorization and its scope/customer/invoice helpers return null or skip all checks without HttpContext or when Request.Path and identity are empty. CustomerSalesInvoiceCollectionAllocationController Create/Void directly calls business services under the same condition. Remove these waivers and always resolve current invoice menu/customer scope and existing receipt funding authority, including all source/target customers and trade-document candidates. Preserve concurrency/amount/currency/shared-budget rules and history; no accounting posting, permission changes or grants. Adapt legacy in-process fixtures only by seeding genuine enabled identities, existing menus/role grants and authorized customers in isolated test data. Do not use request-path presence, test environments, synthetic bypass identities, anonymous/admin fallbacks or empty context to waive authority. Preserve all number/quantity/amount/source/transaction/locking rules and audit. Store complete output/TRX under .ai/logs/<task> with explicit results directories; preserve original failures and do not stage generated output. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: All customer invoice reads/writes/candidates/record/void/allocation and receipt-invoice allocation entries require live enabled identity and their existing menu/source/customer authority independently of request shape. Missing, disabled, deleted, revoked or foreign-scope identity receives a controlled non-disclosing error before counts, candidates, snapshots or mutations.

Retain atomic current invoice/receipt funding validation, shared budgets, currency precision, explicit document/customer lineage and audit. Denied reads return no partial financial/customer/doc evidence; denied create/record/allocate/void produces zero invoice/receipt/source/budget/status writes and never broadens permissions.

Real isolated SQL plus controller regressions cover populated/empty/no-context entry parity, revoked menus and scopes, genuine permitted invoice/receipt flows and zero-mutation/disclosure denial. Adapt legacy invoice/concurrency/exposure fixtures with existing test grants without weakening controls; pass safe Release/full units and retain full logs/TRX.
implementation_evidence: CustomerSalesInvoiceEvidenceController.cs:205-209 path-dependent RequiresLiveAuthorization; BuildScopePredicateAsync:224 and BuildTradeDocumentScopePredicateAsync:231 return null, additional invoice/customer/DTO helpers:242/262/276 waive checks. CustomerSalesInvoiceCollectionAllocationController.cs:124/139 bypass Create/Void authorization via RequiresLiveAuthorization:164-168. ERP-383/434 guard normal HTTP but ERP-468 affects different receipt-allocation controllers, so this waiver remains.
